close_sequence_for_decide: 1. Dispose the 3 open children FIRST (they do not touch the epic doc rev): ae-seeds -> BUILD+close done (demo.ex ~:559 audit comment, D66); ae-search-or-arm-restructure -> rule build-or-descope, if descope close with lifecycle_status=cancelled + reason (LEAD-1 index was live-tried+dropped, so any build must REWRITE criteria first); onb-crosslink -> close done with the triage routing table as evidence (triage IS the deliverable) OR re-parent to onboarding-composition-epic (now dormant).
2. Resync design paper /papers/authoring-excellence Ratified table D56-D67 (stale two waves).
3. Re-claim the lapsed epic: bp task claim authoring-excellence <worker>  -> fresh epoch (lapsed claim cannot stamp).

4. Close epic in ONE atomic write flipping all 4 criteria: bp task close authoring-excellence <worker> <epoch> --set 'criteria:=[...]'  -- criterion 0 evidence must enumerate the 40-child disposition (37 done + ae-seeds done + onb done + ae-search done|cancelled); criterion 3 evidence points at the resynced paper.

5. Dotted content.wave_status: KEEP (D61 default). Scrub ONLY via a literal-key-escaped unset of content['content.wave_status']; a naive dot-path unset of content.wave_status hits the LIVE nested field. Cosmetic; does not block the seal.
